description: Lawn and garden watering advisor — Should I water today? Computes plant water use from the NWS forecast (Hargreaves-Samani reference evapotranspiration from forecast highs/lows and solar geometry, times a plant coefficient), subtracts forecast rain and recent rain → verdict WATER or SKIP, how many inches, the best day (calm, dry, above freezing), per-day highs/lows/rain/ET, and tips (freeze, wind). US only. Params: place= or lat= & lon=; optional plant= lawn|cool-lawn|warm-lawn|garden|vegetables|flowers|shrubs|trees|succulents|native (default lawn), days= 2-7 (default 3), rain_last= inches of rain in the past few days. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_watering
